beginner.summary: For developers, analysts and IT staff who have used a chat assistant but have not run or integrated Meta Llama models themselves. Covers the open-weight model family and licence terms, tokens and context windows, base versus instruct models, chat templates and roles, running models with Transformers, llama.cpp and Ollama, GGUF quantisation, serving an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, hardware sizing, structured output, managed cloud access, a first Llama Guard check, golden-set evaluation, and a local assistant capstone.
prerequisites: Can write and run short Python scripts and use pip or a virtual environment
Uses a terminal confidently, including curl and environment variables
Has a laptop or workstation with at least 16 GB RAM and permission to install software, plus a free Hugging Face account
outcomes: Choose an appropriate Llama model size, variant and quantisation for a task and a hardware budget
Run Llama locally with Transformers, llama.cpp and an OpenAI-compatible server and read their timing output
Write correctly templated prompts, extract structured output and measure quality against a golden set
Explain licence obligations and apply a first safety check with Llama Guard
